title: Dallas Goedert’s contract void date reportedly pushed back

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Dallas Goedert’s contract void date reportedly pushed back
sources.description: Dallas Goedert’s contract was previously set to void by the end of Tuesday, March 10 but that date has since been pushed back to Friday, March 13. This much according to a report from The Athletic’s Zach Berman, who notes that “this procedural move would give both sides a chance to work out a contract […]
